fields.name: active
fields.help: Set active to false to hide the channel without removing it.

fields.name: channel_type
fields.help: Chat is private and unique between 2 persons. Group is private among invited persons. Channel can be freely joined (depending on its configuration).

fields.name: default_display_mode
fields.help: Determines how the channel will be displayed by default when opening it from its invitation link. No value means display text (no voice/video).

fields.name: parent_channel_id
fields.help: Parent channel

fields.name: from_message_id
fields.help: The message the channel was created from.

fields.name: last_interest_dt
fields.help: Contains the date and time of the last interesting event that happened in this channel. This updates itself when new message posted.

fields.name: group_ids
fields.help: Members of those groups will automatically added as followers. Note that they will be able to manage their subscription manually if necessary.

fields.name: channel_name_member_ids
fields.help: Members from which the channel name is computed when the name field is empty.

fields.name: new_message_separator
fields.help: Message id before which the separator should be displayed

fields.name: custom_notifications
fields.help: Use default from user settings if not specified. This setting will only be applied to channels.

fields.name: mute_until_dt
fields.help: If set, the member will not receive notifications from the channel until this date.

fields.name: unpin_dt
fields.help: Contains the date and time when the channel was unpinned by the user.

fields.name: last_interest_dt
fields.help: Contains the date and time of the last interesting event that happened in this channel for this user. This includes: creating, joining, pinning

description: Save favorite GIF from Tenor API

fields.name: server
fields.help: Hostname or IP of the mail server

fields.name: is_ssl
fields.help: Connections are encrypted with SSL/TLS through a dedicated port (default: IMAPS=993, POP3S=995)

fields.name: attach
fields.help: Whether attachments should be downloaded. If not enabled, incoming emails will be stripped of any attachments before being processed

fields.name: original
fields.help: Whether a full original copy of each email should be kept for reference and attached to each processed message. This will usually double the size of your message database.

fields.name: error_date
fields.help: Date of last failure, reset on success.

fields.name: object_id
fields.help: Process each incoming mail as part of a conversation corresponding to this document type. This will create new documents for new conversations, or attach follow-up emails to the existing conversations (documents).

fields.name: priority
fields.help: Defines the order of processing, lower values mean higher priority

fields.name: followers_type
fields.help:
- Specific Followers: select specific contacts to add/remove from record's followers.
            - Dynamic Followers: all contacts of the chosen record's field will be added/removed from followers.

fields.name: activity_user_type
fields.help: Use 'Specific User' to always assign the same user on the next activity. Use 'Dynamic User' to specify the field name of the user to choose on the record.

fields.name: mail_template_ids
fields.string: Mail template using this mail server

fields.name: tracking
fields.help: If set every modification done to this field is tracked. Value is used to order tracking values.

fields.name: automated
fields.help: Indicates this activity has been created automatically and not by any user.

fields.name: activity_state
fields.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

fields.name: activity_exception_decoration
fields.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

fields.name: activity_exception_icon
fields.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

fields.name: res_model
fields.help: Specify a model if the activity should be specific to a model and not available when managing activities for other models.

fields.name: delay_count
fields.help: Number of days/week/month before executing the action after or before the scheduled plan date.

fields.name: delay_unit
fields.help: Unit of delay

fields.name: delay_count
fields.help: Number of days/week/month before executing the action. It allows to plan the action deadline.

fields.name: delay_unit
fields.help: Unit of delay

fields.name: delay_from
fields.help: Type of delay

fields.name: icon
fields.help: Font awesome icon e.g. fa-tasks

fields.name: decoration_type
fields.help: Change the background color of the related activities of this type.

fields.name: res_model
fields.help: Specify a model if the activity should be specific to a model and not available when managing activities for other models.

fields.name: triggered_next_type_id
fields.help: Automatically schedule this activity once the current one is marked as done.

fields.name: suggested_next_type_ids
fields.help: Suggest these activities once the current one is marked as done.

fields.name: category
fields.help: Actions may trigger specific behavior like opening calendar view or automatically mark as done when a document is uploaded

fields.name: initial_res_model
fields.help: Technical field to keep track of the model at the start of editing to support UX related behaviour

fields.name: alias_name
fields.help: The name of the email alias, e.g. 'jobs' if you want to catch emails for <jobs@example.odoo.com>

fields.name: alias_model_id
fields.help: The model (Odoo Document Kind) to which this alias corresponds. Any incoming email that does not reply to an existing record will cause the creation of a new record of this model (e.g. a Project Task)

fields.name: alias_defaults
fields.help: A Python dictionary that will be evaluated to provide default values when creating new records for this alias.

fields.name: alias_force_thread_id
fields.help: Optional ID of a thread (record) to which all incoming messages will be attached, even if they did not reply to it. If set, this will disable the creation of new records completely.

fields.name: alias_parent_model_id
fields.help: Parent model holding the alias. The model holding the alias reference is not necessarily the model given by alias_model_id (example: project (parent_model) and task (model))

fields.name: alias_parent_thread_id
fields.help: ID of the parent record holding the alias (example: project holding the task creation alias)

fields.name: alias_contact
fields.help:
Policy to post a message on the document using the mailgateway.
- everyone: everyone can post
- partners: only authenticated partners
- followers: only followers of the related document or members of following channels

fields.name: alias_bounced_content
fields.help: If set, this content will automatically be sent out to unauthorized users instead of the default message.

fields.name: alias_status
fields.help: Alias status assessed on the last message received.

fields.name: name
fields.help: Email domain e.g. 'example.com' in 'odoo@example.com'

fields.name: company_ids
fields.help: Companies using this domain as default for sending mails

fields.name: bounce_alias
fields.help: Local-part of email used for Return-Path used when emails bounce e.g. 'bounce' in 'bounce@example.com'

fields.name: catchall_alias
fields.help: Local-part of email used for Reply-To to catch answers e.g. 'catchall' in 'catchall@example.com'

fields.name: default_from
fields.help: Default from when it does not match outgoing server filters. Can be either a local-part e.g. 'notifications' either a complete email address e.g. 'notifications@example.com' to override all outgoing emails.

fields.name: email
fields.help: This field is case insensitive.

fields.name: source
fields.help: Canned response that will automatically be substituted with longer content in your messages. Type '::' followed by the name of your shortcut (e.g. ::hello) to use in your messages.

fields.name: substitution
fields.help: Content that will automatically replace the shortcut of your choosing. This content can still be adapted before sending your message.

fields.name: last_used
fields.help: Last time this canned_response was used

fields.name: is_shared
fields.string: Determines if the canned_response is currently shared with other users

fields.name: is_editable
fields.string: Determines if the canned response can be edited by the current user

fields.name: body_has_template_value
fields.string: Body content is the same as the template

fields.name: subtype_ids
fields.help: Message subtypes followed, meaning subtypes that will be pushed onto the user's Wall.

fields.name: body_html
fields.help: Rich-text/HTML message

fields.name: references
fields.help: Message references, such as identifiers of previous messages

fields.name: is_notification
fields.help: Mail has been created to notify people of an existing mail.message

fields.name: email_to
fields.help: Message recipients (emails)

fields.name: email_cc
fields.help: Carbon copy message recipients

fields.name: failure_reason
fields.help: Failure reason. This is usually the exception thrown by the email server, stored to ease the debugging of mailing issues.

fields.name: auto_delete
fields.help: This option permanently removes any track of email after it's been sent, including from the Technical menu in the Settings, in order to preserve storage space of your Odoo database.

fields.name: scheduled_date
fields.help: If set, the queue manager will send the email after the date. If not set, the email will be send as soon as possible. Unless a timezone is specified, it is considered as being in UTC timezone.

fields.name: preview
fields.help: The text-only beginning of the body used as email preview.

fields.name: message_type
fields.help:
Used to categorize message generator
'email': generated by an incoming email e.g. mailgateway
'comment': generated by user input e.g. through discuss or composer
'email_outgoing': generated by a mailing
'notification': generated by system e.g. tracking messages
'auto_comment': generated by automated notification mechanism e.g. acknowledgment
'user_notification': generated for a specific recipient

fields.name: is_internal
fields.help: Hide to public / portal users, independently from subtype configuration.

fields.name: email_from
fields.help: Email address of the sender. This field is set when no matching partner is found and replaces the author_id field in the chatter.

fields.name: author_id
fields.help: Author of the message. If not set, email_from may hold an email address that did not match any partner.

fields.name: pinned_at
fields.help: Datetime at which the message has been pinned

fields.name: starred
fields.help: Current user has a starred notification linked to this message

fields.name: tracking_value_ids
fields.help: Tracked values are stored in a separate model. This field allow to reconstruct the tracking and to generate statistics on the model.

fields.name: reply_to_force_new
fields.help: If true, answers do not go in the original document discussion thread. Instead, it will check for the reply_to in tracking message-id and redirected accordingly. This has an impact on the generated message-id.

fields.name: message_id
fields.help: Message unique identifier

fields.name: reply_to
fields.help: Reply email address. Setting the reply_to bypasses the automatic thread creation.

description: Link between link previews and messages

fields.name: scheduled_datetime
fields.help: Datetime at which notification should be sent.

fields.name: name
fields.help: Message subtype gives a more precise type on the message, especially for system notifications. For example, it can be a notification related to a new record (New), or to a stage change in a process (Stage change). Message subtypes allow to precisely tune the notifications the user want to receive on its wall.

fields.name: description
fields.help: Description that will be added in the message posted for this subtype. If void, the name will be added instead.

fields.name: internal
fields.help: Messages with internal subtypes will be visible only by employees, aka members of base_user group

fields.name: parent_id
fields.help: Parent subtype, used for automatic subscription. This field is not correctly named. For example on a project, the parent_id of project subtypes refers to task-related subtypes.

fields.name: relation_field
fields.help: Field used to link the related model to the subtype model when using automatic subscription on a related document. The field is used to compute getattr(related_document.relation_field).

fields.name: res_model
fields.help: Model the subtype applies to. If False, this subtype applies to all models.

fields.name: default
fields.help: Activated by default when subscribing.

fields.name: sequence
fields.help: Used to order subtypes.

fields.name: hidden
fields.help: Hide the subtype in the follower options

fields.name: track_recipients
fields.help: Whether to display all the recipients or only the important ones.

fields.name: source_lang
fields.help: Result of the language detection based on its content.

fields.name: target_lang
fields.help: Shortened language code used as the target for the translation request.

fields.name: body
fields.help: String received from the translation request.

fields.name: mail_mail_id
fields.help: Optional mail_mail ID. Used mainly to optimize searches.

fields.name: mail_email_address
fields.help: Recipient email address

fields.name: keys
fields.help:
It's refer to browser keys used by the notification: 
- p256dh: It's the subscription public key generated by the browser. The browser will 
          keep the private key secret and use it for decrypting the payload
- auth: The auth value should be treated as a secret and not shared outside of Odoo

fields.name: lang
fields.help: Optional translation language (ISO code) to select when sending out an email. If not set, the main partner's language will be used. This should usually be a placeholder expression that provides the appropriate language, e.g. {{ object.partner_id.lang }}.

fields.name: is_note
fields.help: If the message will be posted as a Note.

fields.name: description
fields.help: This field is used for internal description of the template's usage.

fields.name: subject
fields.help: Subject (placeholders may be used here)

fields.name: email_from
fields.help: Sender address (placeholders may be used here). If not set, the default value will be the author's email alias if configured, or email address.

fields.name: use_default_to
fields.help:
Default recipients of the record:
- partner (using id on a partner or the partner_id field) OR
- email (using email_from or email field)

fields.name: email_to
fields.help: Comma-separated recipient addresses (placeholders may be used here)

fields.name: partner_to
fields.help: Comma-separated ids of recipient partners (placeholders may be used here)

fields.name: email_cc
fields.help: Carbon copy recipients (placeholders may be used here)

fields.name: reply_to
fields.help: Email address to which replies will be redirected when sending emails in mass; only used when the reply is not logged in the original discussion thread.

fields.name: mail_server_id
fields.help: Optional preferred server for outgoing mails. If not set, the highest priority one will be used.

fields.name: scheduled_date
fields.help: If set, the queue manager will send the email after the date. If not set, the email will be send as soon as possible. You can use dynamic expression.

fields.name: auto_delete
fields.help: This option permanently removes any track of email after it's been sent, including from the Technical menu in the Settings, in order to preserve storage space of your Odoo database.

fields.name: ref_ir_act_window
fields.help: Sidebar action to make this template available on records of the related document model

fields.name: can_write

fields.name: message_has_error

fields.name: message_has_error_counter
fields.help: Number of messages with delivery error

fields.name: email_normalized

fields.name: is_blacklisted

fields.name: message_bounce
fields.help: Counter of the number of bounced emails for this contact

fields.name: rotting_days

fields.name: currency_id
fields.help: Used to display the currency when tracking monetary values

fields.name: alias_domain_id
fields.help: If you have setup a catch-all email domain redirected to the Odoo server, enter the domain name here.

fields.name: restrict_template_rendering
fields.help:
Users will still be able to render templates.
However only Mail Template Editors will be able to create new dynamic templates or modify existing ones.

fields.name: use_twilio_rtc_servers
fields.help: If you want to use twilio as TURN/STUN server provider

fields.name: use_sfu_server

fields.name: google_translate_api_key
fields.help: A valid Google API key is required to enable message translation. https://cloud.google.com/translate/docs/setup

Policy on how to handle Chatter notifications:

- In Odoo: notifications appear in your Odoo Inbox

fields.string: Is discuss sidebar category chat open?

fields.string: Use the push to talk feature
